description: Upstream renderStaticScene (packages/excalidraw/renderer/staticScene.ts) at the pinned commit on a recording 2D context (tools/goldens/static-scene.mjs): per scene the inputs and every draw in order with its path, matrix, alpha and styles. Elements are drawn as vectors (renderElement's export path) instead of through the per-element bitmap cache; text measures 10 px per UTF-16 code unit.
